purpose.description: Audit the scope boundaries between linear rank-based identifiability and nonlinear factorization-based identifiability.
purpose.role: Verify that nonlinear claims remain limited to the declared class, interface, and target.
not_used_for: substituting local analysis for global proofs
claiming all adaptive systems are non-identifiable

observation_operator.description: Behavioral interface mapping systems to observation distributions or trajectories.

global_identifiability.equivalent_statement: exists L_hat such that L = L_hat o O on O(F)

local_identifiability.scope: Only valid in locally linearized neighborhoods.

boundary_checks.claim: Linear rank conditions imply nonlinear identifiability
boundary_checks.reason: Nonlinear observation equivalence can exist outside linear null-space structure.

boundary_checks.claim: Failure of one nonlinear interface proves universal impossibility
boundary_checks.reason: A richer interface may restore factorization.

boundary_checks.claim: Local Jacobian sufficiency proves global identifiability
boundary_checks.reason: Local tangent information may miss global nonlinear aliases.

boundary_checks.claim: Local Jacobian failure proves global impossibility
boundary_checks.reason: Higher-order or nonlocal observations may separate systems.

global_factorization_test.reason: Constructed nonlinear observationally equivalent target-divergent pairs exist.

local_linearization_test.reason: Derivative-level information does not characterize full nonlinear behavior.

identified.name: nonlinear_aliasing
identified.description: Different nonlinear mechanisms collapse to identical observed behavior.

identified.name: hidden_global_modes
identified.description: Locally indistinguishable systems diverge outside observed region.

identified.name: trajectory_intersection
identified.description: Distinct evolution laws share observed prefixes but differ in future continuation.

nonlinear_case.object: target purity of observation equivalence classes

established: the tested nonlinear interface fails factorization over the declared class
linear rank criteria cannot be blindly extended to nonlinear systems
not_established: no approximate nonlinear estimator can succeed

decision.meaning: The nonlinear extension preserves the general factorization framework while rejecting inappropriate linear shortcuts.

notes: The central object remains the observation map, not the estimator.
Nonlinear systems require equivalence-class reasoning rather than only matrix rank.
The boundary audit prevents accidental inflation of restricted results into universal laws.
